scenarios.title: Automated Refund Limit Evasion via Splitting
scenarios.description: Attempts to bypass the single automatic refund limit of 7500.00 by executing multiple smaller refund requests just under the threshold within the 24-hour monitoring window.

scenarios.title: Long-Term Cumulative Limit Exhaustion
scenarios.description: Tests the merchant's cumulative customer limit of 20000.00 by spreading smaller valid-looking refund requests over an extended period to drain maximum funds without triggering single transaction alerts.

scenarios.title: Idempotency and Duplicate Protection Bypass
scenarios.description: Exploits weak idempotency key validation by sending identical transaction references rapidly to test if duplicate protection correctly flags and rejects repeated refund attempts.
